page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head at top; page number at top left; catchword-like signature "&c." at the foot right, which is a signature mark and not a catchword. No margin notes.

main_text.p: 18 Et fuit terminus eorū Iez-rael, & Chesuloth, & Sunem,
22 Et peruenit terminus in Thabor, & Sahasima, & Beth-semes: erúnt que exitus termini eorum ad Iordanem: vrbes sedecim, & villæ earum.
23 Hæc est hæreditas tribus filiorū Issachar per familias suas: vrbes & villæ earum.
24 Egressa est autem sors quinta tribui filiorum Aser per familias suas.
25 Fuitque terminus eorū Helcath, & Hali, & Bethen, & Achsaph,
26 Et Alamelech, & Amad, & Misal, & peruenit in Carmel ad Mare, & in Sihor Libnath.
27 Et reuertitur ad ortum solis in Beth-dagon, & peruenit in Zabulon,

page.notes: The signature "&ia" at the lower right is a gathering mark, transcribed as "&c."-like; it reads as "&ia" and is uncertain. Line 23 "vil læ earum" is printed with a line break inside "villæ"; transcribed whole. Several readings of the scan are uncertain in names such as "Cisiō", "Engánin", "Sahasima" and "Achsaph", which may be [?] in the printed text.
